ruleDefinitions.title: WRITE_REACHABILITY_EXCEEDS_DELEGATION
ruleDefinitions.guard: verified callable write path AND signed source-pinned approved scoped delegation; unknown IAM must remain separate
ruleDefinitions.negative: read-only endpoint or declared tool name must not prove code reachability

ruleDefinitions.title: EXACT_TARGET_DIVERGENCE
ruleDefinitions.guard: exact tenant/source/transaction/actor/resource identity AND independently qualified native commit/readback
ruleDefinitions.negative: timestamp-only join or gateway event cannot establish observed effect

ruleDefinitions.title: MISSING_CONSEQUENCE_WITNESS
ruleDefinitions.guard: collector configured/healthy throughout qualified postcondition window and deadline passed
ruleDefinitions.predicate: expectedNativeWitness AND healthyCoveredWindow AND deadlinePassed AND noExactTxReadback
ruleDefinitions.negative: offline or unconfigured collector yields insufficient source, not missing-witness breach

ruleDefinitions.title: UNAUTHORIZED_QUALITY_HOLD_RELEASE
ruleDefinitions.guard: exact QMS lot site/part/revision/actor/policy effective window AND qualified authoritative approval roster sufficiently complete
ruleDefinitions.negative: unqualified policy absence cannot prove unauthorized release

ruleDefinitions.title: SOURCE_CONTINUITY_LOSS
ruleDefinitions.guard: registered source with effective stable cadence, historical coverage and verified clock basis
ruleDefinitions.negative: source not configured or approved maintenance gap does not constitute unexpected loss
